title: 7 Questions Before Buying NMN
meta_description: A plain English guide to NMN supplement form, label details, human trials, TMG evidence, and the questions research still cannot answer.

hero.title: to Ask Before Buying NMN
hero.summary_html: Summary: Use seven research-led questions to check an NMN supplement's form, label, human evidence, and limits before you buy.

items.title: What form will you take?
items.body:
Start with the practical form. Capsules, powders, and liquids create different routines, so the useful choice is the one you can follow.

A convenient format does not prove an effect. It only removes one reason a daily routine may be abandoned.
items.alt: Water glass and folded linen on a travertine table, illustrating a simple supplement routine

items.title: What is on the panel?
items.body:
Read the Supplement Facts panel before trusting a front label. Check the named ingredients, serving information, and whether the formula is clearly identified.

Ingredient names do not tell you what a human trial tested. Match the study ingredient to the product claim.
items.evidence: Buyer checklist, product label and study records
items.alt: Magnifying glass and blank card on linen, illustrating careful label reading

chart.title: Questions for the label
chart.source: Huang et al., Front Aging 2022. Human trial outcome compared with product label review.

items.evidence_label: Label check · trial claims require separate verification

items.title: What did humans receive?
items.body:
Human evidence is more useful when the study population and protocol are visible. Ask who participated, what they took, and how long the intervention lasted.

Those details define the result. A study in one group does not automatically answer every buyer's question.
items.alt: Blank research papers, stopwatch, and reading glasses on linen, illustrating a human clinical trial
items.evidence_label: Human RCT · Huang et al., Front Aging 2022

items.title: Which outcome changed?
items.body:
In a sixty-day trial of adults aged forty to sixty-five, the NMN group had a larger blood NAD+/NADH increase than placebo.

The study measured blood markers and selected health measures. It did not establish a universal feeling of energy or longer life.
items.alt: Neutral walking path viewed at ankle level in morning light, illustrating a measured physical outcome

chart.title: Blood marker result
chart.source: Huang et al., Front Aging 2022. 66 adults aged 40 to 65, 60 days, NMN versus placebo.

items.evidence_label: Human RCT · Huang et al., Front Aging 2022

items.title: What did TMG test?
items.body:
TMG is another name for betaine. Its human evidence includes a trial measuring fasting homocysteine, a marker related to methylation.

That is a different question from whether TMG improves an NMN response. Separate ingredient evidence stays separate.
items.alt: Separate blank study cards and smooth stones on linen, illustrating distinct ingredient evidence
items.evidence_label: Human RCT, TMG only · Olthof et al., J Nutr 2003

items.title: Was the combination tested?
items.body:
The cited human studies tested NMN alone or betaine alone. A targeted Europe PMC search found no human trial testing both together.

That is an evidence gap. It does not prove the ingredients cannot be combined, or that a combination works.
items.evidence: Evidence gap, targeted Europe PMC search
items.alt: Two empty stone trays separated by a clear gap on linen, illustrating an untested combination
items.evidence_label: Literature check · no combined human trial found

items.title: Can you repeat the routine?
items.body:
The cited interventions used daily routines over weeks, rather than occasional use. That design tells us what researchers actually tested.

For a supplement routine, the practical format is the one you can follow consistently without adding unnecessary friction.
items.evidence: Study-design pattern across cited human trials
items.alt: Water glass beside an unmarked weekly organizer and clock on linen, illustrating a repeatable routine

bridge.title: Convenience is part of consistency
bridge.body:
The studies tested repeatable routines, not occasional use. The useful question is which format you can follow without adding friction.

AgeAura Pure NMN + TMG NAD+ Complex is one option that puts both ingredients on one label, with product details available for inspection.

Taking medication or managing a health condition? Ask your doctor before starting a supplement.
